basis: all four gates green with machine checkers; the chain executed end-to-end on the frozen voxelized-Fe study: OpenMC 0.15.3 neutron transport (mesh x 709-group flux tally) -> actinv import-flux -> 64-cell mesh activation with photon output -> export-openmc-mesh spatial sources (one IndependentSource per voxel, Box-bounded) -> executed OpenMC photon transport for both cooling steps -> openmc.deplete comparison leg
conditions: single self-produced geometry: the chain is a qualification of the handoff mechanics, not an external benchmark or validation
the photon leg is a flux-proxy tally (mesh photon flux + void-detector flux), not a qualified dose prediction

the comparison leg used openmc.deplete with TENDL-2025 neutron-branch files + ENDF/B-VIII.0 decay vs ACTINV's pinned TENDL-2025 activation library; median relative deviation over 704 cell-nuclide pairs is 2.14e-7 (max 3.96e-7 in the top-50 by atoms) - solver/flux-noise level, not an experimental claim
neutron tally statistical error is recorded in the statepoint but not propagated into the activation comparison
MCNP SDEF remains point-at-origin (documented placeholder); only the OpenMC path is spatial
g0_amendments: voxelized cube replaces spherical shells (mesh spec carries a fixed mass_g per cell; equal 1 cm3 voxels keep the depletion-leg cell identities aligned)
cooling step indices [1,2] -> [2,3]: actinv step ids are 1-based, irradiation is step 1
